speaker: john_heminges
text: You are not in the shrew, Will. The plot has you nowhere this afternoon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know. Yaxley is done with me until Tuesday. He will not draw it hot. Tuesday at ten. I came to say so, and I am not staying.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Tuesday at ten. You are not cast that day, you said on Wednesday you would keep your own gown until you could not open your teeth. This is not that day. I am not taking a roll you are not giving up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not giving it up. The tooth stays in until Tuesday. Twelve pence when it is out, and not off the share.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Twelve pence is his price. It does not come off the share. Today at two is the shrew. You have heard the start of the morning, and that is enough of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will hear no more of it than this. They can play it without a Roman sitting in the passage to improve it.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: And if the night goes hard, you have only to say so on Monday. I am not asking you which cut stands. Monday can mind Monday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Monday can mind Monday. Today I am going home. The first bran is tonight.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The Rose has The Disguises on the post. I read it coming up. You have read that title before. You do not need to read it again from their yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not going. Tomorrow is Titus, and I am in that one. Today I am in the house.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then go. Twelve pence is cheap if it gives us a mouth that can speak by the sixteenth. Get the morning said, and go home to the bran.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I will be where I am if you want me. I will not come up the stair for a part you still mean to play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Stay where you are. Tuesday at ten is his hour, not a part of yours. I am going.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The shrew does not need a man in the passage to mend it. Go before the yard fills and someone offers you a bench.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not taking a bench. Two of the clock is their hour. Mine was Yaxley's, and it is spent.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He sat me by the window. Lower left, he said, and a cellar, and matter in the gum. I am repeating it so nobody invents a kinder tooth.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Kinder would still be twelve pence and a Tuesday. I am not shopping for a second price.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no second price. He does not want the money while the tooth is in my head. I agree with him, which is new.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Twelve pence on Tuesday, and the part still yours. I will not con a line of it on the chance your cheek swells in the night.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not con it. If the night is bad, Monday hears it from me, not from a roll you have been carrying in your head.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The Disguises is a title on a post. You read it on the second of the month. I am not sending you across the water to read it again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I read it once. Once is the number. Tomorrow I am in Titus, and I will be able to say the death, bran or no bran.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Then I am where the plot already has me. Not in your gown, and not at your lodging. Agreeing with a barber is a kind of health. I will tell no one you managed it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. The hour is told. Tuesday at ten is his, and that afternoon is not a play of yours. Go home to the bran.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am gone. Tell the shrew I was here for the morning and nowhere in it.
